reading.what_is_shown: cover decryption with sk=e is independent of s; the holder of R recovers s (the payload) from c1
reading.what_is_assumed: a party holding only e cannot recover s (RFinding / LWE); this demo cannot prove hardness
reading.size_note: the gadget adds a factor k = log2(q): m = m_bar + n*k, so the carrier is ~k times a square dual-Regev ciphertext
